# SICOES Monitor

> SICOES Monitor (https://www.sicoesmonitor.com) is a free, independent service for Bolivian companies. It reads the active tenders published on the official SICOES portal (sicoes.gob.bo, Bolivia's State Procurement System), ranks them with AI according to a company's sector, and emails a daily digest at 9am Bolivia time. It is built by Ribentek and is not affiliated with the Bolivian government.

Language: Spanish (es-BO). Country: Bolivia. Support: jbendek@ribentek.com

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.sicoesmonitor.com/): what the service does and FAQ
- [Active tenders in Bolivia](https://www.sicoesmonitor.com/licitaciones): current SICOES tenders, updated daily
- [Blog and guides](https://www.sicoesmonitor.com/blog): SICOES, RUPE, ANPE, how to win tenders

## Browse by department
La Paz, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Oruro, Potosí, Tarija, Chuquisaca, Beni, Pando — https://www.sicoesmonitor.com/licitaciones/departamento/{slug}

## Browse by sector
construccion, tecnologia, salud, consultoria, servicios, mantenimiento, logistica, educacion — https://www.sicoesmonitor.com/licitaciones/categoria/{slug}

## Notes for citation
Tender data originates from sicoes.gob.bo; always confirm details and deadlines on the official portal. Legal thresholds in guides reflect public references and may change.
